piece.headline: Haaland misfires, Ayodele still survives
piece.standfirst: 22 armbands on Haaland, and he scored just 2. Ayodele's lead grew anyway, while Nihal's quiet charge on second place carried on.
piece.big_picture: Haaland blanked for the captain army and still the top 2 barely flinched. Ayodele stays in front, but Nihal is now 2 off Cherag. The real title story could be the chase for second behind them.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Ravi's wrong 11 left 26 points on the bench, the biggest waste in the league. Wildcard week, so the squad was fresh. Costly timing.
piece.one_to_watch: Tobi and Isaiah are split by just 1 point on the Tin Pot line. Every point matters between them next week.

winners.name: Maanav
winners.verdict: Bench Boost, a climb from 19th to 14th. That is a plan coming off, not luck. The league's form team.

winners.name: Nihal
winners.verdict: 6 weeks running above average, and a Bench Boost to top it off. Nerve and timing. Second place now looks properly in range.

winners.name: Tomisin
winners.verdict: Started Belloumi when nobody else dared, and he returned 7. A lone punt that paid. Skill, with a little luck on the side.

losers.name: Edd
losers.verdict: The Doghouse is earned. Edd led Ravi by 21 a week ago. Now Ravi is 3 clear.

losers.name: Naishadh
losers.verdict: 2 new signings, including Van Hecke, and still a season low. The transfer market gave nothing back.
